```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("simulated_player_metrics.csv")
```

```{r}
df <- df |> 
  filter(minutes_played > 0)

top_10_teams <- df |> 
  filter(team_rpi_rank <= 10) |> 
  filter(position != "GK") |> 
  group_by(season_year, team) |> 
  mutate(
    max_mins = max(minutes_played),
    mins_percentage = minutes_played / max_mins
  ) |> 
  filter(mins_percentage > .25) |> 
  mutate(
    position_group = case_when(
      position %in% c("CB", "FB") ~ "D",
      position %in% c("DM", "CM", "AM") ~ "M",
      position %in% c("W", "CF") ~ "F",
    )
  ) |> 
  select(team, season_year, player_name, player_id, position_group) |> 
  summarize(
    num_D = sum(position_group == "D"),
    num_M = sum(position_group == "M"),
    num_F = sum(position_group == "F")
  )

non_top_10_teams <- df |> 
  filter(team_rpi_rank > 10) |> 
  filter(position != "GK") |> 
  group_by(season_year, team) |> 
  mutate(
    max_mins = max(minutes_played),
    mins_percentage = minutes_played / max_mins
  ) |> 
  filter(mins_percentage > .25) |> 
  mutate(
    position_group = case_when(
      position %in% c("CB", "FB") ~ "D",
      position %in% c("DM", "CM", "AM") ~ "M",
      position %in% c("W", "CF") ~ "F",
    )
  ) |> 
  select(team, season_year, player_name, player_id, position_group) |> 
  summarize(
    num_D = sum(position_group == "D"),
    num_M = sum(position_group == "M"),
    num_F = sum(position_group == "F")
  )

mean(top_10_teams$num_D)
mean(top_10_teams$num_M)
mean(top_10_teams$num_F)
mean(non_top_10_teams$num_D)
mean(non_top_10_teams$num_M)
mean(non_top_10_teams$num_F)

```
```{r}
library(cowplot)
# 6 RPI tiers: 1-10, 11-25, then teams ranked 26+ split into 4 equal groups within each season
tier_levels <- c("1-10", "11-25", "26+ Q1", "26+ Q2", "26+ Q3", "26+ Q4")

team_tiers <- df |>
  distinct(season_year, team, team_rpi_rank) |>
  group_by(season_year) |>
  mutate(
    rest_quartile = if_else(team_rpi_rank > 25,
                            ntile(if_else(team_rpi_rank > 25, team_rpi_rank, NA), 4), NA),
    tier = case_when(
      team_rpi_rank <= 10 ~ "1-10",
      team_rpi_rank <= 25 ~ "11-25",
      TRUE ~ paste0("26+ Q", rest_quartile)
    ),
    tier = factor(tier, levels = tier_levels)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(season_year, team, tier)

# Rank range actually covered by each tier (the Q1-Q4 cutoffs shift a little by season)
tier_ranges <- df |>
  distinct(season_year, team, team_rpi_rank) |>
  left_join(team_tiers, by = c("season_year", "team")) |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  summarize(rank_min = min(team_rpi_rank), rank_max = max(team_rpi_rank), .groups = "drop")
print(tier_ranges)

# One pipeline for all tiers instead of a copy of the code per tier
team_counts <- df |>
  filter(position != "GK") |>
  left_join(team_tiers, by = c("season_year", "team")) |>
  mutate(
    position_group = case_when(
      position %in% c("CB", "FB") ~ "D",
      position %in% c("DM", "CM", "AM") ~ "M",
      position %in% c("W", "CF") ~ "F"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(season_year, team, tier) |>
  mutate(mins_percentage = minutes_played / max(minutes_played)) |>
  filter(mins_percentage > .25) |>
  summarize(
    num_D = sum(position_group == "D"),
    num_M = sum(position_group == "M"),
    num_F = sum(position_group == "F"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# The 6 groups: tier x position group, with summary stats of players-per-team-season
group_summary <- team_counts |>
  pivot_longer(c(num_D, num_M, num_F),
               names_to = "position_group", names_prefix = "num_",
               values_to = "players") |>
  group_by(tier, position_group) |>
  summarize(
    team_seasons = n(),
    mean   = mean(players),
    median = median(players),
    sd     = sd(players),
    min    = min(players),
    q25    = quantile(players, .25),
    q75    = quantile(players, .75),
    max    = max(players),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, levels = c("D", "M", "F"))) |>
  arrange(tier, position_group) |>
  mutate(across(c(mean, sd), ~ round(.x, 2)))

print(group_summary)

# Same counts for VT, season by season, to set beside the tiers
vt_team <- "Virginia Tech"   # change to "Vermont" if that's the VT you mean
vt_counts <- team_counts |> filter(team == vt_team) |> arrange(season_year)
print(vt_counts)

write_csv(group_summary, "roster_group_summary.csv")

group_labels <- c(D = "Defenders", M = "Midfielders", F = "Forwards")

# 6 shades from dark maroon through VT maroon to light pink
maroon_gradient <- colorRampPalette(c("#4A0E23", "#861F41", "#E8B7C6"))(6)

ggplot(group_summary, aes(x = tier, y = mean, fill = tier)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), width = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = maroon_gradient) +
  facet_wrap(~ position_group, labeller = as_labeller(group_labels)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "RPI tier", y = "Players per team-season (mean, Q25-Q75)",
       title = "Roster makeup by RPI tier")
```
